title: Bell project dates to 1937, per a Serbian source

tellings.quote: I've since been informed by somebody who had relatively direct knowledge, somebody in Serbia. >> Mhm. >> That it went back to 1937.

plain: The Bell, said to be a secret Nazi German device behind a hidden flying-craft programme, supposedly goes back to 1937. The writer Jason Jorjani, who says he found Hitler's secret UFO programme, tells Michels he was 'informed by somebody who had relatively direct knowledge, somebody in Serbia' that the project began that year. If so, the programme started earlier than is usually told.
